name: MetaVoice
description: MetaVoice-1B, a 1.2B-parameter zero-shot voice-cloning TTS model (metavoiceio/metavoice-src). Ships two self-hosted listeners: a FastAPI server (serving.py) exposing POST /tts and GET /health on the distinctive port 58003 (binds 0.0.0.0, CORS *), and a Gradio UI (app.py) on port 7861. No authentication. Project is effectively frozen (company wound down).
auth_notes: No authentication on either service. The FastAPI server (serving.py) binds 0.0.0.0:58003 with CORSMiddleware allow_origins=["*"] and no token/key check on POST /tts. The Gradio UI (app.py) binds 0.0.0.0:7861 (note: 7861, not the Gradio default 7860) with no auth= argument. docker-compose maps 7861:7861 (container metavoice-ui) and a server service for serving.py. No rate limiting on either. The project is effectively inactive (MetaVoice the company wound down), so no auth will be added.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Port 58003 is a near-unique, non-standard port used almost exclusively by the MetaVoice FastAPI server; the /tts path surfaces via the FastAPI /docs and /openapi.json. The port itself is the strongest discriminator.
The FastAPI /docs Swagger UI (title 'FastAPI - Swagger UI') is served on 58003; combined with the distinctive port this reliably isolates MetaVoice servers whose root returns JSON.

Conjunctive: the co-occurrence of the MetaVoice-specific /tts and /health routes (GET /health returns {"status":"ok"}) in the openapi schema on port 58003 pins MetaVoice specifically and excludes generic FastAPI apps.

The MetaVoice Gradio UI runs on the non-standard port 7861 (not 7860); the gradio-app mount on that port is the SPA-blind route to the UI surface - confirm the MetaVoice identity via GET /config since the name is JS-rendered.

known_vulns: Unauthenticated POST /tts on 0.0.0.0:58003 - open TTS/voice-clone synthesis and GPU compute abuse
CORSMiddleware allow_origins=["*"] - cross-site request forgery from any browser origin against the FastAPI server
FastAPI /docs and /openapi.json expose the full API schema unauthenticated
Gradio UI on 7861 carries the Gradio CVE class - CVE-2024-1561 local file read via /file=, path traversal on vulnerable pins
Project effectively frozen (company wound down) - no patches for any future finding
risk_notes: MetaVoice's standout signal is the non-standard port 58003 paired with the defined unauthenticated /tts and /health REST endpoints - a clean, dork-able fingerprint distinct from generic FastAPI. Vectors on an exposed instance: (1) Unauthenticated zero-shot voice cloning / compute theft via POST /tts (JSON in, binary audio out) at operator GPU cost; (2) CORS allow_origins=["*"] enables cross-site-request abuse from any origin running in a victim browser on a reachable network; (3) Full API disclosure via /docs and /openapi.json; (4) the Gradio UI on 7861 adds a second unauth surface carrying the Gradio file-read/traversal CVE class (CVE-2024-1561) on vulnerable pins. The FastAPI surface is JSON at root but /docs and /openapi.json are reachable and carry the /tts + /health schema; the Gradio :7861 surface is a JS-rendered SPA (http.html-blind for the name - resolve via /config). The project is real but frozen (MetaVoice the company wound down, no commits in the trailing window), so any finding is permanent with no upstream fix.
deployment_notes: ~4.2k stars, Apache-2.0, real but effectively inactive/frozen (not formally git-archived; MetaVoice the company wound down). Two listeners defined in docker-compose: 'ui' (Gradio app.py on 7861, entrypoint 'poetry run python app.py') and 'server' (FastAPI serving.py on 58003). serving.py binds 0.0.0.0:58003 with CORS '*'; GET /health returns {"status":"ok"}, POST /tts takes JSON and returns binary audio, and FastAPI auto-docs at /docs + /openapi.json. No published official image on Docker Hub/ghcr - ships a Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml for local build. Server header is 'uvicorn' on both. Model weights metavoiceio/metavoice-1B-v0.1 on HuggingFace. Harvest the FastAPI surface via port 58003 (the strongest discriminator) plus the /tts+/health openapi schema; the Gradio surface via port 7861 + gradio-app, resolving identity through GET /config.
